assessment.subject: anyakrakusuma: log-domain Sinkhorn solver for entropic Schrodinger bridges
assessment.object: four idealized constructed planar transport cases
assessment.claim_summary: A Python log-domain Sinkhorn solver for entropic Schrodinger bridges attains ~1e-9 marginal residual and recovers an imposed 90-degree reorientation to within 0.07 degrees on four constructed test cases; authors note application to empirical clouds needs further study.

assessment.subject: Gaussian Moments Conjecture
assessment.object: explicit polynomial counterexamples in 3 and 4 Gaussian variables
assessment.claim_summary: Explicit complex polynomials in three real Gaussian variables (five terms, degree 4) disprove the Gaussian Moments Conjecture for every dimension n>=3.
assessment.magnitude: disproves GMC for all n>=3 (5-term degree-4 example)

assessment.subject: Lp- and entropically-regularized optimal transport
assessment.object: small-regularization first/second-order asymptotics
assessment.claim_summary: Derives exact first- and second-order small-regularization asymptotics for Lp-regularized (1<p<inf) and entropic optimal transport under mild assumptions, unifying prior quadratic/entropic results via a duality-plus-quantization method.

assessment.subject: risk-sensitive exit-time control of path-dependent SDEs
assessment.object: small-noise deterministic control limit
assessment.claim_summary: Proves that the log-transformed risk-sensitive exit-time control problem for path-dependent SDEs converges in the small-noise limit to a deterministic path-dependent control problem, via a new variational representation.

assessment.subject: continuum directed random polymer (CDRP) temperature chaos
assessment.object: decoupling of free energies across two inverse temperatures
assessment.claim_summary: Proves that CDRP free energies coupled through the same white noise at inverse temperatures (b1,b2) decouple as b2>>b1>>1, converging to independent directed landscapes -- a first rigorous energetic de-correlation-across-temperatures result.

assessment.subject: root recovery in a random uniform attachment tree under G(n,p) noise
assessment.object: bounded-size confidence set containing the root
assessment.claim_summary: Proves that for p=o(log n/n) a confidence set of size K(eps), independent of n, contains the attachment-tree root with probability at least 1-eps (via Jordan centrality on high-degree vertices), affirming a 2021 Crane-Xu conjecture.

assessment.subject: ATLAS: invariant/heterogeneous latent-factor disentanglement across environments
assessment.object: multi-environment factor model / transfer latent-factor regression
assessment.claim_summary: Proposes ATLAS and proves that invariant vs heterogeneous factors are identifiable under a minimal structural condition, with sharp non-asymptotic recovery bounds and near-oracle downstream latent-factor regression across environments.

assessment.subject: multilevel quantum algorithm for parabolic-PDE observables
assessment.object: mesh (h) dependence of quantum estimation complexity
assessment.claim_summary: Presents a multilevel quantum algorithm estimating linear/quadratic parabolic-PDE observables with complexity Otilde(1+(T*eps)^-1) and only polylogarithmic dependence on h^-1, removing polynomial mesh dependence under stated access assumptions.

assessment.subject: MgHCu3 perovskite superconductivity (DFT re-examination)
assessment.object: critical temperature Tc; sensitivity to functional and phonon grid
assessment.claim_summary: DFT recalculation finds MgHCu3's electron-phonon properties are extremely sensitive to functional/grid, giving Tc ~10-31 K that does not exceed the classical 40 K limit, contradicting a prior claim of Tc=42 K.
assessment.magnitude: Tc ~10-31 K, below 40 K classical limit (prior claim 42 K)

assessment.subject: CutBackdoor: circuit-cut-triggered parameter backdoor on VQAs
assessment.object: clean-baseline vs poisoned cut-path reconstruction error on IBM backends
assessment.claim_summary: Introduces a parameter-supply-chain backdoor that leaves full-circuit VQA validation intact yet amplifies cut-path reconstruction (energy) error by 1.3x-2.9x on IBM backends when circuit cutting is triggered; ZNE only partially mitigates it.
assessment.magnitude: 1.3x-2.9x cut-path energy amplification vs clean baseline

assessment.subject: composite quantum gates (B5, SK1, BB1, H5s, X5) via chiral-interference circuits
assessment.object: whole-circuit robustness vs elementary rotations under rotation-angle error
assessment.claim_summary: On IBM hardware chiral-interference circuits reproduce enantiomer-dependent states at ~98%; H5s/X5 composite gates keep high target populations up to 50% rotation error versus ~8% for elementary rotations, but variable-rotation sequences fail to preserve phases.
assessment.magnitude: ~98% target probability; robust to 50% error vs ~8% baseline

assessment.subject: heavy-electron-plasmon-mediated superconductivity in two-carrier systems
assessment.object: optimal Tc via band-structure and quantum-geometric engineering
assessment.claim_summary: Within RPA/Eliashberg theory the plasmon channel alone gives Tc~0.1 K, but cooperating with a moderate phonon attraction boosts Tc above 20 K (about two orders of magnitude); band flattening also favors competing orders.

assessment.subject: boundary-controlled chiral edge states in chiral kagome antiferromagnets
assessment.object: nonreciprocal superconducting transport / Josephson diode effect
assessment.claim_summary: Argues theoretically that sublattice-dependent boundary termination selects single-valley chiral edge states, producing nonreciprocal superconducting signatures (asymmetric Andreev spectra, Josephson diode effect, anomalous Fraunhofer patterns) in transverse junctions.

assessment.subject: quantum particle on a chiral Cayley tree with power-law hopping
assessment.object: local density of states and semi-fractal eigenstate statistics
assessment.claim_summary: Cavity/population-dynamics analysis shows the chiral Cayley-tree model develops power-law LDoS tails and 'semi-fractal' eigenstates whose higher moments behave multifractally, crossing to localization as the hopping-distribution exponent varies.

assessment.subject: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) robustness on IBM Heron hardware
assessment.object: shot budgets, qubit layouts, noise mitigation, CCSD-amplitude perturbations vs clean baseline
assessment.claim_summary: Empirical analysis finds SQD largely robust to CCSD-amplitude perturbations and to layout/noise-mitigation choices (which narrow within a few iterations), but accuracy saturates at moderate shot budgets and very large budgets slightly worsen recovered energies.

assessment.subject: QuantiSpect: factorized lightweight 3D-CNN surface-code pre-decoder
assessment.object: dense CNN baseline and PyMatching on simulated rotated-surface-code decoding
assessment.claim_summary: A structure-aware factorized 3D-CNN surface-code pre-decoder matches a dense baseline's threshold/accuracy with ~2.71x fewer parameters, reduces logical error up to ~1.85x vs PyMatching (d=13, p=0.5%), and speeds PyMatching decode up to 3.11x at d=23.
assessment.magnitude: ~2.71x fewer params; up to 1.85x lower logical error; up to 3.11x faster

assessment.subject: fluid-dynamic baseline for pT correlations C_pT in heavy-ion collisions
assessment.object: QCD equation of state (Lattice QCD at finite mu_B); RHIC BES data
assessment.claim_summary: A unified fluid-dynamic model with Lattice-QCD equation-of-state inputs reproduces the centrality scaling of transverse-momentum correlations C_pT from sqrt(s)=3-200 GeV; peripheral deviations at top energies suggest onset of non-thermal correlations.

assessment.subject: tunable non-Abelian gauge field in an active mechanical lattice
assessment.object: Wilson-loop observables; non-Hermitian skin-mode localization
assessment.claim_summary: Experimentally realizes a tunable non-Abelian gauge field in a measurement-and-feedback mechanical lattice, extracts Wilson-loop observables confirming genuine non-Abelian character, and shows non-Hermitian gauge potentials switch skin-mode localization between chain ends.

assessment.subject: doped C=1/3 fractional Chern insulator (parton construction)
assessment.object: color superconductors and Z3 / U(1)^2 holon-metal phases
assessment.claim_summary: Develops a parton framework for doping a C=1/3 fractional Chern insulator, predicting charge-2e color superconductors formed directly from charge-e/3 anyons without binding, plus several Z3 orthogonal-metal and holon-metal phases.

assessment.subject: eco-evolutionary public-goods game on networks with differential diffusion
assessment.object: emergence/promotion of cooperation vs defector dominance
assessment.claim_summary: Models an eco-evolutionary public-goods game where faster defector dispersal drives a symmetry-breaking transition producing localized cooperator clusters; a degree-based mean-field reduction shows connectivity controls a bifurcation favoring cooperative hubs.

assessment.subject: AlphaFold2 Evoformer weights probed by Gaussian-convolution 'neural spectroscopy'
assessment.object: encoded protein conformational landscapes (ubiquitin, KaiB, alpha-synuclein); noise controls
assessment.claim_summary: Smoothing AlphaFold2's Evoformer weights yields physically structured conformational landscapes: ubiquitin contacts break in experimentally known order, five models agree KaiB's alt fold is not recovered, and matched-power noise controls yield only debris.

assessment.subject: driver site frequency spectrum in a supercritical two-type birth-death process with selection
assessment.object: moments, strong laws of large numbers, cutoff frequency
assessment.claim_summary: For a supercritical two-type birth-death process with mutation and selection, derives exact moments and proves strong laws for the driver site frequency spectrum, identifies a cutoff frequency, and enables estimation of mutant fitness parameters.
